status: AUTHORITATIVE OWN-SQUAD COMPANION LOGIC CONTRACT — FINAL PRE-CALIBRATION
principles: Game/native data controls legality, white skills, tactic options, exact condition drain, Playstyle eligibility and Mentor effect identity.
The decision system uses only the manager own squad, assigned XI, player skills, Playstyles, Special Abilities, saved Mentor unlock/level state, Approach and Drain Limit.
No opponent formation, opponent strength, opponent tactics, scouting profile or relative-strength estimate is accepted or inferred anywhere in the decision runtime.
Community evidence influences transparent companion ranking only where no private Nordeus best-value table exists.
Every active bonus or penalty must have a human-readable explanation string.
Hard legality gates are evaluated before soft scores.
Locked Mentor boost families contribute exactly zero.
A Mentor effect that requires unavailable external/live-match information receives zero pre-match ranking credit rather than a guessed substitute.
Training only gives utility to actual white skills; grey skills never receive utility.

Individual Training optimises the desired Role+Playstyle attribute shape: higher-value white skills are intentionally developed above lower-value white skills instead of equalising the whole white set.

Verified drill intensity is real gain input: Very Easy/Easy/Medium/Hard/Very Hard map to base XP 1/2/3/4/5 per player. Drill level or Master effect multiplies that strength; exact final attribute gain remains server-authoritative.

Captaincy has no proven match-performance effect in the recovered current client. Historical Nordeus Support explicitly stated captain choice does not strengthen players or change stats; Captain therefore contributes zero Team Plan ranking value.

squad_blueprint.matching_policy: Assign unique players to simultaneous core functional slots; a player may not fill two required slots at once. Versatility is reported separately.
squad_blueprint.quality_gap_policy: A slot can be structurally covered but still flagged weak if its best assigned-role quality is materially below the current first-XI median.

core_slots.label: Left defensive cover
core_slots.why: Keeps direct coverage against right-sided opposition threats and enables a back four.

core_slots.label: Second central defender
core_slots.why: Gives the minimum two-DC base used by resilient shapes.

core_slots.label: Right defensive cover
core_slots.why: Keeps direct coverage against left-sided opposition threats and enables a back four.

core_slots.label: Defensive midfield screen
core_slots.why: Protects the central lane and gives direct structural cover against AMC-heavy shapes.

core_slots.label: Central midfield connector
core_slots.why: Links defence, buildup and attack and helps avoid midfield numerical deficits.

core_slots.label: Left attacking progression
core_slots.why: Provides a natural left-side attacking route and preserves two-sided progression when paired with right-side width.

core_slots.label: Central creator / between-lines threat
core_slots.why: Creates a natural central receiving/creation route between midfield and the striker line.

core_slots.label: Right attacking progression
core_slots.why: Provides a natural right-side attacking route and preserves two-sided progression when paired with left-side width.

core_slots.label: Primary forward
core_slots.why: Provides a natural final-third outlet and scoring reference.

flexibility_slots.label: Third centre-back option
flexibility_slots.why: Unlocks three-centre-back systems without dismantling the rest of the squad.

flexibility_slots.label: Second central midfielder
flexibility_slots.why: Allows central overloads, double-pivot systems and safer rotation.

flexibility_slots.label: Alternative forward profile
flexibility_slots.why: Gives a different route to goal when the starting forward profile does not suit the selected team plan.

flexibility_slots.label: Left mid/wing depth
flexibility_slots.why: Keeps both advanced-width and midfield-width systems available.

flexibility_slots.label: Right mid/wing depth
flexibility_slots.why: Keeps both advanced-width and midfield-width systems available.

availability_depth_slots.label: Reserve goalkeeper
availability_depth_slots.why: Prevents one unavailable goalkeeper from making the squad structurally incomplete.

availability_depth_slots.label: Defensive utility reserve
availability_depth_slots.why: Covers injuries/rotation across the defensive line or screen without using a starter twice.

availability_depth_slots.label: Central midfield reserve
availability_depth_slots.why: Preserves central structure when a first-choice midfielder is unavailable.

availability_depth_slots.label: Attacking utility reserve
availability_depth_slots.why: Maintains a credible alternative attacking route and protects against one unavailable attacker.

coverage_score.slot_score: covered strong=1.0; covered but weak=0.6; missing=0.0; multiply by slot importance then normalise inside each layer
coverage_score.note: Versatility is reported as a benefit but never creates a second simultaneous player.

formation.candidate_policy: Use the game/legal role assignment plus the 12 curated structural families. Rank only by the manager own fieldable squad; no matchup/scouting input exists.

assignment_policy.best_available: Use 11 unique players. A slot may be filled only by a role currently listed for that player. Do not solve a missing role by silently placing a player out of position.
assignment_policy.dynamic_fallback: If none of the curated families can be fielded naturally, generate legal shapes from the squad natural-role pool and score them with the same rules. Curated formations are candidates, not a whitelist.
assignment_policy.multi_role: A multi-role player may be assigned to only one slot in a candidate XI. Their other roles count only as flexibility after that assignment.
assignment_policy.playstyle_role_fit: If a player has an active Playstyle, full Playstyle-fit credit applies only when the assigned role is eligible for that Playstyle in build 30527. A natural role that is not Playstyle-eligible remains legal but loses Playstyle-fit credit.
assignment_policy.out_of_position: Emergency wrong-position use is never part of the normal optimiser. If the user explicitly enables emergency mode, show it as a warning and keep it outside the normal score comparison.

component_normalization.lineup_quality: For each fieldable candidate, mean assigned_role_white_mean. Across candidates, map worst to 0 and best to 35; if all equal, all receive 35.
component_normalization.playstyle_role_fit: 10 × (active Playstyle starters assigned to an eligible Playstyle role / active Playstyle starters). Players without an active Playstyle are neutral.
component_normalization.weak_link: Take the minimum assigned_role_white_mean in the XI. Across candidates map worst to 0 and best to 15; if all equal, all receive 15.
component_normalization.core_structure: Start at 15 neutral, add/subtract own-squad formation rules, clamp to 0..30.
component_normalization.formation_flexibility: 0..10 from the selected XI natural-role versatility. A player still occupies one current slot and is never counted twice in the XI.

tactics.selection: Enumerate legal 11-dimension tactic combinations under the chosen drain ceiling; score lineup fit + structural context + coherence + Playstyle/SA semantic fit + drain efficiency.
tactics.drain_policy: Drain is a hard user ceiling first; within the ceiling it is a secondary efficiency preference, not the primary objective.

Counter Attack Stopper.note: Effect mapping remains unresolved, so it contributes zero to pre-match tactic ranking.

tactics.neutral_policy: Neutral/default options are explicit candidates. Lack of a specialist bonus is not itself a penalty. Balanced/Mixed/Mid options receive small fallback support when evidence for either extreme is weak.

component_normalization.native_lineup_fit: Mean normalized XI support across the 10 non-mentality dimensions, scaled to 0..32.
component_normalization.own_squad_structure: Sum own-XI structural rule points, clamp raw to -13..+13, then map linearly to 0..26 with 13 neutral.
component_normalization.internal_coherence: Sum tactic-to-tactic coherence rule points, clamp raw to -9..+9, then map linearly to 0..18 with 9 neutral.
component_normalization.playstyle_and_sa_fit: Sum active Playstyle/Special Ability semantic rule points once per identity, clamp raw to -7..+7, then map linearly to 0..14 with 7 neutral.
component_normalization.drain_efficiency: After the Drain Limit hard gate, map raw condition-drain score from the theoretical minimum eligible plan to the selected limit ceiling: minimum=10 points and ceiling=0 points. Ceilings are Low 40, Medium 65, High 100.

prestige.policy: Prestige upgrades Signature Move. Do not invent extra recommendation points from Prestige unless actual CurrentEffects are available; report it as stronger current Signature state only.

formula.tactical: 0 or tactical_max according to the Mentor tactical condition. If a Mentor entry uses a graded feature rather than a boolean condition, low/medium/high map to 0/20/40 unless the entry supplies a different table.
formula.attribute: For the two boosted attributes, sum role-hierarchy tier weights only where that attribute is white for the starter assigned to that role, then apply active tactic-context multipliers. Convert raw relevance to 0..25 using target raw relevance 24; score = 25*min(1,raw/24). Grey occurrences contribute 0.
formula.signature: 0 or signature_max only when its explicit activation/context condition is known true. Unknown/live-only conditions receive 0 prematch rather than guessed partial credit.
formula.tradeoffs: Apply only when the relevant family is unlocked and context active. Tradeoff penalties never unlock before their family.
formula.plan_adjustment: mentor_adjustment = 10 * clamp((raw_total + tradeoffs)/95,0,1). This adjustment is applied only inside the viable core-plan band.

mentors.attribute_impact_policy: Attribute boost score uses current XI assigned-role white-skill coverage and current plan relevance, not raw count alone.

state_policy.manual_state: The manager manually records each Mentor level/Prestige. Level 0 or missing means unavailable and must not be recommended.
state_policy.unlock_gate: Tactical contributes only at level >=1; Attribute only at >=5; Signature only at >=10. Locked families contribute exactly zero and are shown as locked.
state_policy.prestige: Prestige changes the real Signature CurrentEffects if/when those values are captured. Prestige number alone never creates guessed recommendation points.
state_policy.halftime: Research-only note: some real Mentor effects can change with later match context, but the v0.5.12 pre-match own-squad runtime does not accept halftime/live state and gives those conditions zero pre-match credit.

mentors.runtime_context: Own XI + selected tactic + saved Mentor unlock/level state only. No scouting or live-match state is accepted.

set_pieces.status: LIVE v0.5.14 COMPLETE XI SET-PIECE PACKAGE — CAPTAIN GAMEPLAY-NEUTRAL
set_pieces.provenance: The game proves the assignment slots and specialist ability identities. No official automatic ranking formula has been recovered for set pieces. For Captain specifically, historical Nordeus Support stated the choice does not make a player stronger or change stats, and the recovered current build exposes assignment/save state but no captain performance formula.

free_kick.left_right_policy: Evaluate both slots from the same proven inputs. Without a captured preferred-foot field the optimiser must not invent a left/right-foot advantage, so the same best player may legitimately lead both lists.

corner.left_right_policy: Evaluate both slots from the same proven inputs. Without a captured preferred-foot field the optimiser must not invent a left/right-foot advantage, so the same best player may legitimately lead both lists.

captain.status: GAMEPLAY-NEUTRAL DEFAULT — NO PROVEN CAPTAINCY EFFECT
captain.reason: Because Captain has no proven gameplay effect, the optimiser must not invent Bravery, age, leadership, personality or hidden captain coefficients. Top Eleven Tool auto-fills the highest-OVR starter as a convenient cosmetic default, using assigned-role quality only as deterministic tie-breaks. Any manual Captain choice is treated as performance-equivalent.

set_pieces.team_plan_influence: Penalty/free-kick/corner readiness is calculated for every candidate XI and used only as a late deterministic tie-break after final/core plan score. Captain is explicitly excluded from readiness and contributes zero to Team Plan selection.
set_pieces.manual_override_policy: Every automatic assignment may be manually overridden. Manual choices persist until the user explicitly refreshes recommendations or the assigned player leaves the XI.

training.playstyle_activation: Locked/no Playstyle level uses the base role profile. Standard/Intermediate/Advanced/Master use the role-specific Playstyle profile. Do not scale priority further by level without evidence.

deficiency.reference: Role+Playstyle target-shape normalized reference, not the raw top-three white-skill mean.
deficiency.formula: desired_ratio by tier -> normalized current values -> mean(top three normalized development-role whites) -> per-skill target -> positive target gap -> hierarchy/context weighted need.
deficiency.reason: Creates specialists by making the most valuable white skills intentionally higher than lower-value white skills while still reacting to the player actual current profile.

drill_scoring.harder_drill_policy: With identical targeted useful white skills and the same level/effect, a higher-intensity drill has strictly higher max-growth utility because its verified base XP is higher.
drill_scoring.base_utility: strength * sum(remaining_weighted_need for targeted white skills)
drill_scoring.condition_efficient_mode: compare utility / condition_drop after all legality rules; the base XP/condition ratio is proportional across Very Easy→Very Hard, so intensity alone does not create a fake condition-efficiency advantage.
drill_scoring.exact_gain_boundary: ExecuteTraining returns the server-authoritative final per-player AttributeGain. The companion ranks drills by verified XP/effect strength but does not claim an exact predicted +X attribute result.

training.multi_role_policy: Use one development role for the main hierarchy; secondary natural roles expand the white-skill union and can add small support value, but do not replace the primary role hierarchy.

context_caps.reason: Long-term training identity must remain role/Playstyle-led; a current match plan may tune priorities but must not completely redefine the player.

gap_labels.critical: weighted need >= 1.35 × median weighted need for this player
gap_labels.note: Labels are relative within the player; they are not claims about hidden game caps.

target_shape.status: LIVE v0.5.14 ROLE+PLAYSTYLE ATTRIBUTE TILT + VERIFIED INTENSITY GAIN
target_shape.provenance: Transparent companion development model; these are desired relative attribute proportions, not recovered hidden Nordeus coefficients or hard caps.
target_shape.reference: Mean of the top three current normalized levels among the selected development-role white skills, where normalized level = current skill / desired tier ratio.
target_shape.behaviour: A flat player is deliberately tilted toward S then A skills. Once an important skill reaches the desired Role+Playstyle shape, its catch-up gap collapses to the small maintenance floor and training shifts to the next underdeveloped important white skill instead of equalising every white skill.
target_shape.no_absolute_cap: The model does not invent an absolute 180/200/etc player-skill cap. It controls relative shape only.

joint_selection.status: LIVE v0.5.14 COMPLETE OWN-SQUAD TEAM-PLAN SELECTION — FINAL PRE-CALIBRATION
joint_selection.viable_band: A candidate is Mentor-eligible only when its core plan score is within 10 points of the best core plan.
joint_selection.mentor_adjustment: 0..10 from the best unlocked Mentor own-plan fit. It is applied only inside the viable band.
joint_selection.final_score: core_plan_score + mentor_adjustment for viable candidates; non-viable candidates retain core_plan_score and cannot be rescued by Mentor fit.
joint_selection.no_mentor_policy: If no Mentor is unlocked, adjustment is 0 and the plan remains valid.
joint_selection.set_piece_integration: A complete automatic set-piece/captain package is generated for every candidate XI. Penalty/free-kick/corner readiness is a late tie-break only; Captain is gameplay-neutral and excluded from the tie-break. Set pieces are non-additive and cannot rescue a weaker core plan.

feature_model.principle: Every symbolic rule feature resolves from the selected own XI, its current player data, or the selected tactic. Unknown or external information is never requested, inferred or guessed.

skill_reference.assigned_role_white_mean: Mean of the current player skill values in the build-30527 white-skill map for the role the player is assigned to in this candidate XI.
skill_reference.xi_quality_median: Median assigned_role_white_mean across the 11 assigned starters.
skill_reference.action_cluster: Mean of the explicitly named current skill values for the eligible players. Match-plan analysis may read any real skill value; the white/grey restriction applies to training utility and Mentor attribute relevance, not to whether a skill value exists.
skill_reference.strong_cluster: A player is a strong outlet for a cluster when the cluster is at or above the 67th percentile of eligible own players and is not more than 10 points below xi_quality_median. With fewer than three eligible players, use xi_quality_median - 10 as the floor.

aerialOutlet.true_when: any eligible starter has Target Man OR satisfies strong_cluster for Heading+Strength+Positioning
aerialOutlet.reason: Used only to decide whether deliberate aerial service has a credible receiver.

counterOutlet.true_when: any eligible starter satisfies strong_cluster for the transition cluster OR has Poacher/Inside Forward with Speed at or above xi_quality_median-10
counterOutlet.reason: Represents a credible first transition receiver/runner, not a hidden counter-attack multiplier.

directOutlet.true_when: aerialOutlet OR any ST satisfies strong_cluster for Strength+Positioning+Heading OR counterOutlet
directOutlet.reason: Required before long/direct distribution receives contextual credit.

technicalBuild.bands: low < xi_quality_median-5; medium within ±5; high > xi_quality_median+5

pressCapacity.bands: low < xi_quality_median-5; medium within ±5; high > xi_quality_median+5

lineSpeed.bands: low < xi_quality_median-5; medium within ±5; high > xi_quality_median+5

markerCapacity.bands: low < xi_quality_median-5; medium within ±5; high > xi_quality_median+5

boxFinishing.value: mean of best two eligible action_cluster values, or the only value if one exists

longShotThreat.value: mean of best two eligible action_cluster values. Shadow Striker is handled separately as semantic evidence and does not secretly inflate this number.

dribbleReliance.true_when: at least two advanced starters (AMC/AML/AMR/ST) have Dribbling >= their assigned_role_white_mean OR use False Nine, Enganche or Inside Forward
dribbleReliance.reason: Pre-match context for Shearer tactical-family relevance; it is not assumed from his identity alone.

defensiveActionDemand.bands: high when selected mentality is defending/hardDefending OR pressing is high with Counter Press; medium when pressing is mid OR tackling is aggressive; low otherwise
defensiveActionDemand.reason: Own-plan demand feature for Vidić. It describes how defensive-action-heavy the selected tactic is; it does not estimate events from another team.

directSupport.value: mean of the best available directOutlet/counterOutlet/aerialOutlet cluster; categorical comparison helper only

technicalBuildValue.value: same numeric action_cluster mean used to band technicalBuild
technicalBuildValue.reason: Numeric companion used only for transparent Mixed-vs-direct support comparison.

evaluation_context.external_context_policy: Unavailable external or live-match conditions contribute zero rather than being estimated.

best_available_now.alternatives: Keep at least two strategically different viable core plans when their final scores are close.

recommendation_output.explainability: Every non-zero companion rule contribution must surface a valid message key. Scores without reasons are test failures.
recommendation_output.runtime_scope: Own-squad pre-match planning only. Formation, Tactics, Set Pieces/Captain, Mentor and player-development context are derived from the manager own squad; Captain is treated as gameplay-neutral; no scouting fields are produced or consumed.
